svg.title: Certificate hierarchy sketch: one emSign ECC root, a stack of eight intermediate CA certificates whose keys were recoverable, and a separate stack of about 30,800 certificates that chained to the root
svg.desc: A root certificate plate labeled emSign ECC Root CA - G3 sits above two branches. The left branch leads to a stack of eight intermediate certificate plates marked recoverable keys, seven unused and one in production, with zero end-entity certificates issued. The right branch leads to a stack of certificates for a US client ecosystem, about 30,800 of them, which chain to the root rather than to the eight and are moving to a G1 root. A footer lists four dates: 30 April 2025 key ceremony, 17 October report and Chrome block in 1 hour 40 minutes, 18 October revocation, 27 October root removal due.

g.text: now moving to a G1 root
chain to the root, not the eight
